description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Scan and remediate dependency CVEs before Azure deployment.
tasks.reason: Security remediation is required in every modernization plan to reduce risk before production deployment.
tasks.requirements: Scan all project dependencies for known CVEs and remediate vulnerabilities by upgrading to patched versions. If remediation requires major-version upgrades, document upgrade risk and breaking-change impact. Verify the project build and tests after remediation.

tasks.description: Deploy the modernized Java application to Azure Container Apps.
tasks.reason: The modernization objective is to run the application on Azure using a repeatable deployment flow.
tasks.requirements: Containerize the application as needed and deploy to Azure Container Apps using existing or newly provisioned Azure resources. Use Managed Identity for Azure authentication where applicable.
